notes.title: Development progress update
notes.content:
Hey gamers!
What should you expect for blackhole simulator at release.
-legacy system which will give you a long term goal while playing 
-blackholes can evolve into different things
-50+ upgrades 
-pets
-hard mode enemies 
-boss enemy's
-new planets
-updates 
-An updated store page will happen soon just been working hard trying to polish this game
-a completely original concept with original artwork.
-weekly updates 

The demo was a sliver of the actual game. I am very excited for people to play this. I wanted to make this into a game I would want to play.

Thanks for your continued support and appreciate all of you!
Lunatic AKA tyler

notes.title: Demo update 2 evolution and pets out now
notes.content:
with demo update 2 finished heres what was added to the game

-added the 20 gold clicker (when bar fills up gives you money even when in the menu)

-added 1 new enemy the protomech(hard) hes on par with the final boss of the demo 

- 2 new acheivements protomech kill 10, missle kill 10

-added 2 new planets to the game which are very expensive but worth it :D

-added 2 new pets to the game lightning drone and stone gollum

-added evolutions glitched black hole and galaxy black hole.

-fixed some more optimization issues with enemy collisions made it more streamlined

these updates are intended to be in cohesion with the perk system im adding next should be the final update of the demo coming next.

HAPPY GAMING!,

lunatic (aka tyler)

notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE: Planetary and save system
notes.content:
with demo update .30 it adds a ton of features the list is as follows

-added 7 new enemies to the game.

-added new absorbtion zone where you just have to be in the zone for so long and you get money and experience
 
-added the start of the demo end game content with different enemies higher tier acheivements etc.

-fixed the save system completely, it was completely redone from the ground up

-swapped out some ugly art work to get it to match the game better.

-added enemies to delete when far enough off screen (performance)

-added planet diablo which is a very important buff for late demo gameplay.
 
-made the new enemies work with existing systems properly. this was a major task.


next update you might see the beginning of the next black hole evolution.

notes.title: demo is released major update coming soon
notes.content:
Hi im tyler the developer for black hole simulator!

with the next update coming tommorow the following features will be added.

-3 new upgrades

-5 random events 

-the acheivements system will be implemented

-save system fixed

-the planet system added in that will add new events to the game

-possibly more 

-im gonna look at the demo tonight and see if there is more that could be added or if im just gonna continue on the full version. the goal is to have the demo stop at level 10 and end further level progression there. however you might still encounter some of the random events.

happy gaming
